Plot a fine stair geometry

Source: R/plot_stair.R, R/plot_stairs_V3.R
plot_stair.Rd

Plots a stair geometry using physical tread and riser surfaces, including their thicknesses.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'stair_geometry'
plot(x, ...)

plot_stair(
  geometry,
  tread_thickness = 0,
  riser_thickness = 0,
  riser = TRUE,
  legend_columns = c(`Step begin` = "x_tread_start", `Step end` = "x_tread_end", Riser =
    "x_riser"),
  col = "white",
  border = "black",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A stair_geometry object.

...

Additional graphical parameters passed to plot().

geometry

A stair geometry data frame containing physical surface coordinates.

tread_thickness

Thickness of the tread.

riser_thickness

Thickness of the riser.

riser

Logical; whether to draw risers.

legend_columns

Character vector of geometry columns to display as horizontal axes. Each column is displayed on a separate line. Unknown columns are ignored. If NULL or if no valid column is supplied, no axes are displayed.

col

Fill colour of the stair surfaces.

border

Border colour of the stair surfaces.

Value

Invisibly returns the fine geometry used for plotting.
